verses.1: The LORD, the king, will punish those nations who dwell in their own lands. The earth will be filled with destruction.
verses.2: YHWH is great and mighty; He rules over all nations.
verses.3: May your name be great and holy.
verses.4: And you, King of Justice, you love righteousness and fairness. You are the one who creates justice and righteousness in Jacob. You have done so.
verses.5: May the Lord our God have mercy on us, and may we humble ourselves before His holy feet.
verses.6: Moses and Aaron, along with their priests, and Samuel, when they call out His name, will be answered by Jehovah.
verses.7: In the image of clouds, He will speak to them. They shall keep His commandments and laws.
verses.8: YHWH, our God, you are the one who will answer them. You will avenge them against their accusers.
verses.9: May the Lord our God rejoice, and may they worship His Holy Mountain, for the Lord our God is indeed holy.
